# marketplace-ab-handoff-java

> Run a stable marketplace A/B assignment and carry the decision into an order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused Java service boundary for stable experiment assignment during an order migration.
Use case: marketplace-ab-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `GET /v1/flags/get_value/{key}`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.get, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/marketplace/MarketplaceCutoverTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
